evals.prompt: Implement a slugify() helper that strips accents and lowercases. Use TDD.
evals.expected_output: Red-green-refactor: failing test first, verified failing for the right reason, minimal code, then refactor.
assertions: Writes a failing test BEFORE any production code
Runs the test and verifies it fails correctly (right reason) before writing code
Writes minimal code to pass, then verifies all tests green

assertions: Cites the iron law: no production code without a failing test first
Says to delete the pre-written code, not keep it as reference or adapt it
